setting: You are all members of an allotment society in a market town in the English Midlands, and you share its one site on the edge of town. Derek chairs the society, Tracey is its secretary, Sam is its treasurer, and Zoe and Stan are plot holders there. It is late November, so the site is quiet, and this chat is mostly used to plan the January AGM agenda and to organise a bulk compost order.
openers: Ask who can help clear the leaf-covered paths
Check the water tank for frost
Thank everyone for the raffle prizes
opener: Check the water tank for frost

private_lines.Derek: You live in a market town in the English Midlands, spend your days advising part-time at a garden centre and chairing the allotment society, and live with Tracey.
private_lines.Tracey: You live in a market town in the English Midlands, spend your days working as a practice nurse and as the allotment society's secretary, and live with Derek.
private_lines.Sam: You live in a market town in the English Midlands, spend your days as an IT support technician and the allotment society's treasurer, and live alone.

text: Going down to check the water tank for frost. Looked like it went under last night
Tank's iced over at the top. Breaking it with the stick. Won't leave till it's clear
Did you put the lagging on the outside tap?
Did it last week
Ok just checking
morning! is the gate on the car park side locked? went past at 8 and it was open
Shut it on the way out. Probably the lads from the flats cutting through
ok thx
Compost quote came through. £412 for 20 bulk bags delivered, minimum 10 per drop. Who needs what
Stan doesn't need any surely, he's got his own heap
Send it through Sam. Can we split 20 between the usual lot?
[photo: the compost quote]
Ask him if they're the 40 litre or the 60. The 40 are no use for the bed I'm doing
Not sure. Will check

Clinic was dead this morning, just me and one lad with a cut thumb. Got the AGM draft done from last year's minutes. Items so far: treasurer's report, plot rents, shed, election of officers, AOB. Anything else?
Shed roof
Already on there. Shed roof, water supply, north fence
can we add parking? sorry if I'm the only one who keeps going on about it
Not the only one. Put it down
AGM date? 25 Jan is a Mon, hall should be free that week
25th is fine. Hall booked? Derek?
Not yet. I'll ring Maureen
Frost on the path this morning. Went round with the fork.
Water's on still.
just got in. long day, we had a lab in with a fishhook through its lip he's fine. off to bed early
Ouch. Glad he's ok
Compost: put me down for 3 bags
Need a count by Fri to put the order in
Me 2. Pls chase Maureen Derek
Rang Maureen. Hall's free 25th, 7pm. £35
Ok paid from the hall fund, I'll note it
So 7 bags so far. Need 3 more to hit the minimum of 10
I'll do 3!! 🌱🌱 is that enough for the bulk price?
Yep 10 hits it 👍
amazing ty sam
Who's collecting?
They deliver to the gate. Lorry only fits the one way round
Tell him not to block the tap
Derek is that the tank again
No, bed. Night
